views.label: SSO first
views.note: Federation is the first step in the target account — keep a break-glass admin enabled in case it locks you out.

views.label: Groups before grants
views.note: A workspace-local group must become an account-level group before grants and workspace attachments work correctly.

cards.title: Federation is rebuilt, not migrated
items: SAML/OIDC and SCIM are reconfigured against the target account, because the cloud identity provider changes or is scoped differently
Configure this first in the target account, before anything else depends on it
Service principals need OAuth-token authentication confirmed too, not just human SSO

cards.title: Workspace-local groups are the trap
items: Grants and workspace attachments only work correctly against account-level groups
Convert before migrating, not after — the mechanics are export, recreate at account level, reassign, retire
Not all identity providers flatten nested groups the same way — verify, don't assume

cards.title: Keep a way back in
items: A local account admin stays enabled through this whole sequence as break-glass access
Test SSO with a non-admin user, not the admin doing the configuring
If federation fails, reconfigure and retest against the same break-glass account, not a new one
